elements.name: Aquarius
elements.text: Aquarius: idealistic, nonconformist vision, moving to its own rhythm toward hope.

elements.name: Star halo
elements.text: The eight-pointed star crowning her: the light seen at the end of the tunnel, hope made luminous.

elements.name: Vessel
elements.text: The vessel raised in her hand: an open-handed gift poured out into the world, faith offered without needing anything back.
